finish.summary:
Bug: `nodeNameToToolName` in `packages/workflow/src/tool-helpers.ts` could return an empty string when truncating to 64 characters left only trailing separators (`_`/`-`), because the cleanup regex `replace(/[_-]+$/, '')` stripped the entire string.

Fix: After truncation and trailing separator removal, if the result is empty, fall back to `'_'` (a single underscore is a valid tool name). This ensures the function always returns a non-empty, valid tool name.

Change: Added 3 lines to `packages/workflow/src/tool-helpers.ts` (a guard after the `.replace()` call).
Test: Added 2 test cases to `packages/workflow/test/tool-helpers.test.ts` covering the exact reproduction cases from the issue.
finish.risks: Minimal risk: the guard only triggers in the edge case where the entire truncated name consists of separators. All existing tests continue to pass (24/24).
finish.tests_run: `cd packages/workflow && pnpm exec vitest run test/tool-helpers.test.ts` — 24 passed (22 existing + 2 new)
